def max_non_palindrome_substring(s):
    n = len(s)
    dp = [[False] * n for _ in range(n)]
    max_length = 0
    
    for i in range(n-1, -1, -1):
        for j in range(i, n):
            if i == j:
                dp[i][j] = True
            elif i + 1 == j:
                dp[i][j] = s[i] != s[j]
            else:
                dp[i][j] = s[i] == s[j] and dp[i+1][j-1]
            
            if dp[i][j]:
                continue
            
            max_length = max(max_length, j - i + 1)
    
    return max_length

            left -= 1
            right += 1

    for i in range(n):
        len1 = expand_around_center(i, i)
        len2 = expand_around_center(i, i + 1)
        max_length = max(max_length, len1, len2)

        left -= 1
        right += 1
    return s[left:right]

        # Odd length palindromes

        if len(odd) > max_length:

            result = odd
        if len(even) > max_length:
            max_length = len(even)
            result = even
